final: SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(1.0 * scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) FROM scans JOIN sites ON CAST(sites.zoneregistry AS TEXT) = CAST(scans.zoneref AS TEXT) WHERE CAST(scans.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(scans.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY sites.riskeval
